title: Defense lists initial witnesses in Sara Duterte impeachment trial
summary: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte has listed at least 24 initial witnesses it intends to present upon the resumption of the impeachment trial next week.

blocks.text: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte has listed at least 24 initial witnesses it intends to present upon the resumption of the impeachment trial next week.

In a statement, Senate impeachment court spokesperson Regie Tongol said the court received two formal manifestations with requests for subpoena duces tecum and ad testificandum filed by the defense on November 4, in compliance with the five-day notice directive, covering the hearings from November 9 to 13.
Twenty-five individuals were listed as intended witnesses of the defense next week—first of whom is law professor Dean Ralph Sarmiento, who has declined to testify as a witness.

Based on Tongol's statement, Sarmiento was supposed to testify on legal and constitutional principles relevant to the impeachment case and on Article II, which pertains to allegations on unexplained wealth of the vice president.
Aside from Sarmiento, here is the schedule of the other intended witnesses of the defense next week:

items: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay — Corporate Counsel, Gencorp Industries, Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corporation

blocks.text: She is set to testify on relevant corporate and business matters linked to the vice president and produce certified true copies and/or original copies of the General Information Sheets, Audited Financial Statements, and all other related corporate records from 2022 to 2025.

items: Engr. Jaime Adalin — City Assessor, Davao City

blocks.text: He is set to testify on matters in relation to the tax declarations and tax maps pertaining to the Matina Crossing Property discussed during the prosecution's presentation, and bring certified true copies of the tax declarations of a property with Transfer Certificate Title 146-2024010775, tax mapping records of Davao City, and other related documents.

items: Engr. John Kenneth Enumerables — City Assessor, Island Garden City of Samal

blocks.text: He is set to testify on matters in relation to the tax declarations and tax maps pertainingto the Island Garden City of Samal Property discussed during the prosecution's presentation, and present relevant documents.

items: Vingelin Bajan — City Accountant, Davao City

blocks.text: Meanwhile, the following are set to testify on matters relating to the vice president's remuneration while she was holding office in Davao City, and to produce certified true copies and/or original copies of the payroll records, vouchers and other documents showing release and/or payment of salaries:

blocks.text: The impeachment court said the identities of the remaining witnesses for the November 19, 20, and 23 hearings will be disclosed soon in accordance with the five-day notice requirement.

Presiding officer Senator Francis "Chiz" Escudero will review and act upon the subpoena requests in strict accordance with the rules of procedure and the court's standards on relevancy and admissibility. — VDV, GMA News
